info.name: Family Schedule - Resend Member Invite
info.description: Resend an expired member invite as its owner or an admin (admin, super_admin, sub_admin). Set base_url to your API origin, access_token to a valid owner/admin JWT, and member_id to the Member record ID (not the User ID). The recipient must still need a password change and have an expired temporaryPasswordExpiresAt. Success sends a new temporary password by email and gives it 48 hours of validity. No request body is required. A successful resend makes another immediate resend return 400 because the new password has not expired.

variable.description: API origin without /api/v1 or a trailing slash. Change the port to your server port.
JWT access token of the member owner or an admin. Do not include the Bearer prefix.
Member document _id for an expired pending invite, not the recipient User _id.

request.description: Uses collection Bearer authentication. Sends a new temporary password to the member email. Response contains memberId, email and temporaryPasswordExpiresAt; it does not include the password. Expected failures: 400 invalid ID, unexpired password, or no pending temporary invite; 401 missing/invalid token; 403 unrelated owner; 404 missing member/recipient/owner; 409 concurrent invite or password change. SMTP failure returns an error and conditionally restores previous credentials so the invite can be retried.
